html:
SMTO-OBS-0005 — SMTO found more than one matching piece of work

GUID: 931050e5-dbe6-5fbb-b6d4-dbe9456f3fad
Slug: execution-observation-ambiguous
Domain: OBS · Subsystem: execution

What happened

  • Several runs in this conversation fit what was asked for, and none is the one clear choice, so SMTO won't guess which to show. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Expand Inspect execution under the exact reply you're interested in, instead of asking about the whole conversation. Opening it from one reply tells SMTO exactly which run you mean.
  2. If you asked the Agent to check on earlier work, tell it which step you mean, for example by quoting the command it ran or the reply it gave. The Agent can then look up that one step instead of every run in the conversation.
  3. If a script or tool you use asks SMTO for these details, have it include the request, activity or operation identity, not just the conversation. With only a conversation, several finished runs can match equally well.

What success looks like

  • The details shown belong to the reply or step you chose.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't start the work again to make it easier to find; that could repeat it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Execution observation matched more than one retained native run for the supplied scope (typically a conversation-only or task-only lookup) and no single still-active run could disambiguate them, so it returned 409 instead of choosing one.

What this means

  • Observation finds multiple matching retained executions without exactly one active candidate that can disambiguate them. Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.

Why this can happen

  • Observation finds multiple matching retained executions without exactly one active candidate that can disambiguate them.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect available request/activity/operation IDs and select the intended one explicitly.

How to fix it

  • Supply request_id or run_id, activity_id or operation_id to GET /api/agent/executions/<identity>/observation, the conversation progress endpoint or the inspect_execution control so exactly one retained run matches. Do not replay work to create a unique match.
  • Supply the specific request, activity or operation identity from the current conversation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • The narrowed scoped request resolves to exactly the intended execution.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.

Technical notes

  • Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
